FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

PSV host G.A. Eagles at Philips Stadion in round 14 of the Eredivisie. The odds bookmakers offered on the match give PSV a 77% chance of winning, compared with 9% for G.A. Eagles.

Current Form - PSV

PSV sit first with 29 points from 13 matches, having won nine, drawn two and lost two, with a 44-16 goal record. Their last league match ended in a 4-1 win away to Nijmegen. Across their last five matches, PSV recorded three wins, one draw and one loss; they scored 3.6 goals per match in that span, compared with 3.4 across the season, while their average conceded remained 1.2. PSV recorded six home matches without defeat.

Current Form - G.A. Eagles

G.A. Eagles are ninth on 17 points, with four wins, five draws and four losses from 13 matches and a 24-28 goal record. Their last league match was a 0-1 home loss to Sittard. Their last five matches brought two wins and three losses, with scoring at 1.0 goal per match compared with 1.8 across the season; their average conceded was 2.2 in both periods.

Head-to-Head Record

The last five meetings produced an average of 3.4 goals. PSV won four of their last five meetings against G.A. Eagles and lost one. PSV won their last 17 meetings at home against G.A. Eagles. Last season, PSV won 4-1 away to G.A. Eagles, with G.A. Eagles at home.

PSV vs G.A. Eagles
Flashscore
Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Sven Mijnans, a midfielder, has nine goals and three assists in 11 matches for PSV, making him the league's joint top scorer; he scored five goals across his last four matches and found the net in three of them. Ruben van Bommel has five goals and three assists in 12 matches, while Guus Til has seven goals and two assists. Alassane Plea is unavailable after surgery.

Soren Tengstedt leads G.A. Eagles with nine goals and two assists, ranking joint third among the league's scorers; he scored three goals in his last four matches and scored in two of them. Mathis Suray has three goals and four assists, while Melle Meulensteen has one goal and two assists in 12 matches. Evert Linthorst is a doubt for this match.

Key Numbers

↔️ Yellow cards: PSV 23 vs G.A. Eagles 12

PSV

➕ Headed goals: 0.62 per match (best in the league, league average 0.28)

➕ Through passes: 2.1 per match (2nd best, league average 1.2)

➕ Expected goals conceded (xGA): 1.27 per match (4th best, league average 1.70)

G.A. Eagles

ℹ️ Tackles: 10.9 per match (fewest in the league)

ℹ️ Throw ins: 21.4 per match (most in the league)

Match Notes

Filip Kostic has three yellow cards in six appearances across the last 10 matches. Eus Waayers is at G.A. Eagles after arriving directly from PSV's academy; he made zero appearances and scored zero goals across zero seasons for PSV.

Betting Insights

The odds give over 2.5 goals a 79% probability, while both teams to score is priced at 64%.
